title: Extraction of gDNA from Synechocystis 6803
author: Dennis DD Dienst
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.k99cz96

steps.title: Pellet cells from culture
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 50 mL Synechocystis 6803 culture (OD 0.4–1.0) for 7 min at 4000 g, 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash pellet with TE
steps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 10 mL TE buffer, centrifuge 7 min at 4000 g, 4 °C; repeat the resuspension and centrifugation once more.

steps.title: Resuspend in TES and freeze
steps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 1 mL TES buffer, snap‑freeze in liquid nitrogen (wear goggles).

steps.title: Incubate lysate
steps.instruction: Incubate the frozen/thawed sample either 1 h at 60 °C with gentle agitation or 16 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Enzymatic lysis
steps.instruction: Add lysozyme to 5 mg mL⁻¹, 3.2 U proteinase K, and 100 µL 20 % SDS; incubate 1 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: First phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume (1 vol) phenol/chloroform/isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1), mix, centrifuge 10 min at 12 000 g, 4 °C; transfer the aqueous phase to a new 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Second phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 1 vol phenol/chloroform/isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1) to the transferred aqueous phase, mix, centrifuge 10 min at 12 000 g, 4 °C; transfer the aqueous phase to a fresh tube.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 0.7 vol isopropanol to the aqueous phase, incubate 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 30 min at 12 000 g, 4 °C to collect the DNA pellet.

steps.title: Wash and dry pellet
steps.instruction: Remove supernatant, add 300 µL 70 % ethanol, air‑dry pellet 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried pellet in 30–100 µL TE buffer.

steps.title: RNase treatment
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL RNase A, incubate 30 min at 37 °C, then 10 min at 72 °C.
